profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer - building software solutions to fulfill worthy missions
profile.summary:
My new role has me dipping my toes in many different technologies - from aged Java/PHP/& C apps, to AWS and everything that comes with that universe.  Learning about Lambdas and Serverless has been eye opening and an enjoyable perspective.  Transitioning to the mission of supporting Libraries, enabling them with tools to help people self educate, building a stronger society.

Prior role was a Full-Stack Developer supporting/guiding/developing the company's Branded websites focusing on lawn care.  Stabilizing and customizing Content Management platforms' capabilities to support seasonal Business campaigns for Digital Marketing.  Led a mid-sized team for a couple years on older platforms, allowing the other team(s) time to build the future platform(s) to replace our Drupal/Magento platform eCommerce sites.

A Software Engineer with over 25 years dedicated to building server side and Internet applications. Primary role as an independent contributor building solutions using PHP/SQL/Linux/Drupal/Magento and also IIS/ASP. Acted as Tech Lead providing Leadership to the Business as they transform to meet the ever-evolving Consumer demand.  Prior role involved integration of C++/C# components into the .NET company flagship security suite.  Also in a prior role, built software solutions for AOL's flagship Video platform.

Specialties: Languages:  		
PHP, Java, C/C++, C#, PERL, JSP, JS, ASP, Obj-C, Python, AWS
Software/Tools:
Drupal, Magento, mySQL, Eclipse, Oracle, ATG, MSSQL, IIS, VMWare, Flex 2.0, Apache, MSVC++, Embedded VC 4.0, SQL CE, IIS, Cloudflare, MarkMonitor

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Member of a team whose mission is to modernize several aged applications. Transition to cloud – specifically AWS.
positions.insights: Skills: Java · PostgreSQL · Bash · JavaScript · Node.js

positions.title: Senior Web Analyst/Analyst II/Tech Manager
positions.description:
* Leads Drupal/PHP Development team, partnered with cross-functional Teams, providing Marketing Support.
* Led team which built eCommerce capabilities (Magento) for Core Drupal sites. 
* Several years of feature requests, migrated websites from ATG 2007.1 to Drupal. 
* Built custom APIs in ATG to drive mobile apps.  
* Completed development of ATG website portfolio, deployed and stabilized BCC capabilities. Transitioned websites from branded cohort to independent Brand sites.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description: Built CRUD sites using open source technologies

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Enhanced and refined software components for the Network Access Control utility within the security software suite.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Projects were chat, file finder, stock quotes, SNAC over FLAP authentication, Netscape ISP, and finally AOL Video Player.

positions.title: Senior Consultant
positions.description:
Senior Consultant 
- completed and delivered a working version of a WinCE application;  in this case we delivered a Titration System.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: Began as a TASL (tax analyst structured language) programmer.  Developed data entry screens and print forms for tax forms supported by H&R Block.  Then became involved with CompuServe's forum software.  The system was written in BLISS and ran on specialized 36 bit DEC servers.  Forums had two main components, messages and files and my responsibilities revolved around enhancing the forum files management software.  AOL acquired CompuServe in 1997.
